label: Ilford Delta 3200
source: HARMAN technology Limited, ILFORD DELTA 3200 PROFESSIONAL Technical Information (Jun 2025); curves traced from the PDF's raster chart images (spectral page 1, characteristic curves page 5)
notes: Approximate digitization; not supplied or endorsed by HARMAN technology. All three charts are embedded raster images (no vector curve paths); curves were traced at the images' native resolution after thin grid and frame lines were removed by a 3x3 grey opening, axes calibrated on the printed grid lines and tick marks. Characteristic curves (page 5): two charts, 'DELTA 3200 Professional film developed in ILFORD ILFOTEC DD-X 1+4 for 7,9,12 and 16min at 20C/68F' and the same for ILFORD MICROPHEN stock; all eight curves are in all_curves. Curves were matched to their printed time labels by density order (longer time, higher density); the order is the same along the whole chart. channels.k is MICROPHEN stock 9 min at 20 C/68 F: the 20 C development table (page 3) gives MICROPHEN stock 9 min for the recommended meter setting EI 3200/36, the only charted curve whose time equals the table time for EI 3200 (ILFOTEC DD-X 1+4 is 9 1/2 min there, between the charted 9 and 12 min). In the toe the four curves of each chart run together into one band (below relative log exposure about 0.5) and partly merge further up; there each curve was placed inside the band at its edge (outermost curves at the band edge less the stroke half-width, inner curves in the order and spacing last seen where they were separate), so toe densities are uncertain by about 0.02-0.03 D. x is the chart's own 'Relative log exposure' axis (labels 1-4, arbitrary origin), not log H in lux-seconds; density axis labelled 1.0 and 2.0, zero taken at the bottom grid line by the equal grid spacing; tracing noise was removed with a running maximum so density is non-decreasing. log_h_ref: none. The charts carry no 18% grey, speed-point or normal-exposure mark, and the text gives only the film speed (ISO 1000/31 to daylight, measured with ILFORD ID-11 at 20 C/68 F with intermittent agitation in a spiral tank; recommended meter setting EI 3200/36 (exposure rating text, page 1)), so no reference exposure is placed on the relative axis. Spectral sensitivity: 'Wedge spectrogram to tungsten light (2856K)'; the vertical axis is labelled 'Sensitivity' with only two ticks, 0.5 and 1.0, and no statement whether it is linear or logarithmic; values are read on that tick scale as charted (linear between and beyond the ticks), so the curve ends where it meets the chart's bottom frame, which lies at -0.12 on that scale. No granularity or MTF data are published. Not recorded (no field in this schema): contrast-time graphs (page 5), processing-temperature charts (page 5), reciprocity graph (page 2, Ta = Tm^1.33).
